sentences.sentence: Nationalism and Identity Among Middle East Immigrants to Australia
Attention in the social sciences is focusing on the impact of globalization on cultural as well as national identities of immigrants.

It is argued that improved global links is having an effect on how immigrants develop their identity and sense of nationalism or their nation, but for some the links to the country they immigrated from does not weaken.
In the case of the Middle East immigrants who have come to live in Australia there are many factors at play.
In this essay I will argue that these immigrants still identify strongly with their home countries despite now living in a new country.

These factors include the fact that a significant number of immigrants were forced to leave and also that the culture of the countries they left has had an impact on how they view the place where they have immigrated.
In terms of the number of people who are migrating, it is clear that there is a significant amount of migrants coming into Australia.
The Middle East migrants make up around 10 percent of this which is over two million people.
In terms of the people leaving the Middle East, many have chosen to be part of the migration due to the lure of finding a job and providing better lives for themselves and their family.
Other people have been forced to leave through various means such as conflict or the need to flee because of the persecution they faced in their own homeland.
These types of migration do not give them the choice to find a place where they can integrate into the community with less trouble.
Instead, they are forced to find somewhere to live away from what has happened to them and to their loved ones.

For these people who have been forced to leave the places that they came from, the feeling they have when they arrive somewhere else may be different to those who went as part of migration due to work.
One factor could be the feeling of being a victim.

sentences.sentence: ### Employment for People With Disabilities
The issue of people with disabilities finding adequate employment has been a matter of constant debate for the longest time.
The reason being is that it’s not an easy task to make sure they are employed.
Although a number of companies are now taking up the call to hire people with disabilities, a large proportion of them still cannot manage to do so due to the many hindrances put before them.

The concept of reasonable accommodation, which was introduced to the United States as a way of making it easier for employers to hire persons with disabilities, has proven to be the best option so far.
In this essay, I am going to discuss reasonable accommodation, and how this can help to make the employment process less difficult for the disabled in the US.
The discussion will also cover the challenges that the persons with disabilities have to go through when they look for work and how to overcome those challenges.
The conclusion at the end should provide a summary of the essay.
Reasonable accommodation means conditions created for a person with a disability for the professional performance of their qualified work.
Such accommodation should create equality and not cause additional inconvenience (Ewing, 2018).

Examples of such accommodation in the American are as follows: A person who uses a wheelchair should be given an easy access ramp, if there is one, or should be assisted from the outside in the case of an absence of ramps; another example would be that there should be a system of elevators and escalators for the benefit of those who are physically handicapped.
In addition to this, the persons with a disability should be able to find an appropriate and comfortable seat in the workplace so that their working environment can be as normal as possible.
Persons with a hearing problem should also have a system of communication that allows them to hear without any difficulty.
However, even after putting these reasonable accommodations into place, it is still not enough.

sentences.sentence: Critical Review on The light in their eyes by Sonia Nieto and Reflective Teaching: An Introduction by Kenneth Zeichner and Daniel Liston Critical Essay
This paper is aimed at reviewing such books as The light in their eyes by Sonia Nieto and Reflective teaching: An introduction by Kenneth Zeichner and Daniel Liston.
The books deal with education specifically the field of education of people from a particular race or ethnicity.

The light in their eyes by Sonia Nieto discusses her experiences which include the challenges she faced in the classroom when teaching students who were immigrants and came from different cultural backgrounds to the United States.
The book is a memoir of the author and she talks about her experiences while teaching.
As for the book, Reflective Teaching: An introduction by Kenneth and Daniel the authors discuss the meaning of reflective teaching and they also outline the history of this method.
They define it as a method used by teachers to think deeply about their own teaching practices and it is a very important factor in improving one’s skills.

They further go ahead and explain that reflective teaching is used by many scholars in the field of education and the fact that it was adopted by a number of teacher preparation programs is clear evidence of the importance of the method.
Nieto explains some of the methods that she used in order to be effective when teaching her students.
According to the author, there was a lack of respect from her students who were from a non-white community and hence she had to come up with some ways to make them feel more comfortable.
She felt like she needed to do something about how these children viewed themselves and to help them to have self-confidence as well as respect for their own identity.
In the end she was able to create a connection with them through the use of music and stories.
Nieto explains what she learned from her students.
She says that they helped her to understand that they had a problem with their language.

sentences.sentence: Analytic Philosophy: The Views by Wittgenstein and Ayer
Philosophy is an attempt of human beings to logically explain the processes that take place in the world.
There are numerous branches of philosophy including philosophy of nature, history, and language among others.
In the 20th century, the analytical philosophy school emerged and it is characterized as a method which seeks to make use of logic to study the problems of philosophy (Chihara, 2016).
This form of philosophy was mainly influenced by the English people such as Gilbert Ryle and John Searle.
Two of the most prominent philosophers of this school are Ludwig Wittgenstein and Bertrand Ayer who were both influential during their time in developing this area of thought.
The main problem that these philosophers seek to address through their works is how do we understand the meaning of our words, especially when there are various possible meanings?
According to these philosophers, a word can be understood only if it has an exact meaning for the person using it, which is not the same as the dictionary definition given to it.
In his work Tractatus logico-philosophicus, Wittgenstein puts forward the following views.
He claims that in order to understand the meaning of a sentence, one must first of all find out what kind of object is being talked about in the sentence.
For example, if someone says that they love apples, then it must mean that the speaker likes the object of talk i.e.
In contrast, if someone said that they love the colour red, it means something different because it is a property of the object but not the object itself.
In the above two cases, the sentences have the same verb 'love' but they refer to different objects.
Therefore, according to the philosopher, the meaning of a word is found in the relationship between a word and what it refers to.

sentences.sentence: Epidemiology and Environmental Health Essay
The 2009 H1N1 Pandemic is a term used to describe the spread of a disease over large geographical areas, where a disease starts from a given area or location and then spreads.
It started in the U.S. after an outbreak was reported in Mexico.
The infection caused by the influenza virus was transmitted through direct or indirect contact with infected people.
The pandemic affected more than twenty-one thousand people globally, with about two hundred eighty people dying (Scheffler et al., 2023).
When the pandemic was first recorded, it was suspected to have been caused by the swine flu, which is why it was later termed as “swine” or “pig” type influenza.
However, scientists later discovered that this influenza came from the bird flu.
The pandemic is thought to be a result of human-to-human transmission of the bird’s flu that had undergone an evolutionary change and adapted to the host cell of humans.

When a new pandemic occurs, scientists must be able to detect the pathogen causing the epidemic, determine how the pathogen enters the body, and understand the disease in order to come up with an appropriate treatment.

In this case, the World Health Organization (WHO) worked with different countries to find out the cause of this pandemic, which led to the understanding that the new virus had originated among the pigs in North America but it was also present among the birds and humans (Woo et al., 2018).
The understanding of the origin and the spread of the virus was instrumental since it enabled the WHO and other health organizations to work on a vaccine.
The environmental and the public health aspect of this pandemic became a subject of interest for researchers and scholars.
It is widely acknowledged that the environment is a vital aspect when investigating the cause of pandemics.

sentences.sentence: Earnings Management and Earnings Quality Research Paper
Introduction
Earnings describe the benefits of an organization, which is the content of the wage report and a summary thing in the financial report.
Earnings are the fundamental thing in the financial report because they give a clear picture of the financial performance of an organization within a specified period.
This is why it's necessary for the management of the firm to understand the different aspects concerning earnings like quality and manipulation.
It has been argued that the manipulation of the earnings of the company is the most prevalent form of accounting fraud.
The purpose of this paper is to give a thorough evaluation and analysis of earnings management and earnings quality.
The analysis will provide evidence on how earnings management can be used to manipulate earnings as well as the effect of such manipulation on the earnings quality.
Body

The earnings management in an organization is defined as the process through which the managers of the organization alter the reported income or the reported expense in order to improve the financial position of the firm.

The earnings of the company can be manipulated through the use of accounting rules as well as the use of earnings management policies, the use of these two ways will always affect the earnings of the company (Liao, 2010).
According to a study done by Liao, when companies engage in earnings management practices, they tend to increase their stock price.

He also argued that earnings management could be employed during the fiscal years with lower than average earnings to make up for the loss and the next year, this would mean that the earnings of the firm for consecutive years would be manipulated and not based on reality.
Another factor affecting earnings quality in the organization is the manipulation of the reported profit through the use of the change in the reported assets of the firm.
A company may overstate the assets on its balance sheet and in doing so, the firm is likely to reduce the expenses of the firm.
In turn, the earnings of the company may be inflated, thereby resulting in an increased profit.

sentences.sentence: Measures of Central Tendency and Dispersion Research Paper
Aim of the paper
The paper seeks to carry out a descriptive analysis of a data set.
Specifically, the data will focus on estimating the measures of central tendency using the data for a hypothetical population of people who visit the gym every day in a month.
The study has the aim of finding out how many people visit the gym regularly using the measures of central tendency.
Introduction
In the field of statistics, the measures of central tendency are very important as they are used to summarize the characteristics of a data set.
A measure of central tendency is defined as a single value that describes a way in which the values in a data set tend to cluster around a middle.
Such a value is referred to as being representative of the whole set of data.
There are three types of measures of central tendency; mean, median, and mode.
The use of measures of central tendency in the analysis of a data set allows researchers to easily interpret the data set (Creswell & Plano Clark, 2017).
The mean or average is a measure of central tendency, it involves adding up all the numbers together then dividing by the number of items in the set.

The mean provides the arithmetic average of a set of numbers, it gives a very good idea of where the center of a data set is for linear variables but it does not give details on the distribution of the rest of the numbers.
The median or the middle value is another type of a measure of central tendency.
In this case, the numbers are arranged from lowest to highest then the middle value is the median (Bluman, 2015).
The last type of a measure of central tendency is the mode.
Mode is the value that occurs most often in a list of numbers (Bluman, 2015).

When we do not conserve energy, we burn more fuel which contributes to carbon dioxide in the atmosphere, which is one of the main causes of global warming (Hoffman & Hoffman, 2015). Carbon dioxide is a greenhouse gas that traps heat in the atmosphere and leads to global warming. When there is global warming, we experience climate change where temperature and weather patterns change in ways that are not natural. The changing weather affects the whole world. It affects the environment, food production, animals and human beings.

By using less electricity, we will be reducing the amount of fuel required to generate it. For instance, if individuals and companies in Kenya can manage to cut down their energy usage during peak times, there will be reduced load on the power plants and hence reduced burning of fossil fuels such as coal and oil. This will then result in lower emissions of carbon monoxide, nitrogen oxides, and sulfur dioxide into the air, thus reducing the pollution and protecting our environment.
